integrity: The two exhaustive C++ sources use distinct interleaving and bitmask-plus-automaton algorithms; both give zero 3-uniform words. The explicit upper construction is cited and separately tested on finite widths. The theorem is not contingent on extrapolating the finite tests.
limitations: The new lower bound is a complete finite computational obstruction for a 12-vertex induced graph, propagated by induced-subgraph monotonicity; larger numbers of rows remain unresolved. No independent external audit has occurred.
title: Representation number four for every three-row rook graph of width at least four
